edges.notes: Clang lowers C family to LLVM IR (clang.llvm.org).
rustc uses LLVM as a primary code generation path (rustc dev guide / project docs).
LLVM source-level debugging documentation describes DWARF emission paths.
LLVM backends emit ELF object files and linked images on common Unix-class targets.
LLVM outputs may be linked with GNU ld or LLVM lld; objdump/readelf vs llvm-objdump varies by deployment.
LLVM codegen and LTO outputs are commonly linked with lld in LLVM-native stacks.
Clang is the primary C/C++/Objective-C frontend that feeds LLVM IR into the LLVM pipeline.
LLDB is part of the LLVM project and shares release/integration context with LLVM toolchains.
